post_exit_proc_census.selection: Exact owned-root cwd prefix (including deleted-cwd symlinks) or exact current-tested binary executable symlink; no unrelated process argv/environ or private file content read

scope_justification: Unchanged B Node launcher and Python ACP peer inherit the owned workspace cwd and never chdir; fake CLI is shell-builtins-only. Product uses explicit owned --cwd. This census checks those owned identity markers after exit without another product run.
live_observer_limitation: Original live monitor inspected main-thread children only; only uv PID was recorded and no product PGID was captured. [INFERENCE] thread-owned subprocess creation may explain the missed tree; exact cause was not inspected. all_observed_product_groups_gone=false means unobserved, not a detected surviving group. No claim of a captured-complete live descendant tree.
